title: Pure Sky Striker
summary: Sky Striker cards with generic hand traps and staples. The page's combo lines add Pot of Desires and Radiant Typhoon Vision, and its hybrid section adds Mitsurugi, so they use cards this list leaves out. Raye tags into a Sky Striker Ace Link from the Extra Deck, and the Spells only work while your Main Monster Zones are empty. The 2026 cards lead: Lemnisgate! shuffles Aces and Spells back to bounce cards and Link Summons on either turn, Camellia mills a Sky Striker each turn, S.P.E.C.T.R.A. negates for two banished Spells, and Engage Zero! wipes the field once Raye and Roze are in the GY.
main: Sky Striker Ace - Raye
Quick Effect: Tributes itself to summon a Sky Striker Ace Link to the Extra Monster Zone; comes back when that Link leaves.
Sky Striker Ace - Roze
Summons itself when another Ace arrives; from the GY, negates a monster.
Pillar of the Future - Cyanos
Discards a Spell to summon itself and brings Roze from the Deck or GY.
Sky Striker Mecha - Adil Saber
2026 support. Discards for +1500 ATK in battle, and equips itself to a Sky Striker Link from the GY.
Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage!
Searches any Sky Striker card; draws with three Spells in the GY.
Sky Striker Mecha - Widow Anchor
Quick-Play: negates a monster and steals it with three Spells in the GY.
Sky Striker Mecha - Hornet Drones
Limited. Makes an Ace Token for Link material.
Sky Striker Special Maneuver - Lemnisgate!
2026 support. Shuffles Aces and Spells back to bounce cards; from the GY, Link Summons an Ace.
Sky Striker Mobilize - Linkage!
Quick-Play: sends a card to summon a Sky Striker Ace Link from the Extra Deck.
Sky Striker Mecha Modules - Multirole
Your Spells can't be answered, and Sets used Sky Striker Spells again at the End Phase.
Sky Striker Airspace - Area Zero
Digs three for a Sky Striker card; sent to the GY, summons an Ace from the Deck.
Sky Striker Maneuver - Afterburners!
Destroys a face-up monster, and a Spell/Trap with three Spells in the GY.
Sky Striker Maneuver - Jamming Waves!
Destroys a Set Spell/Trap, and a monster with three Spells in the GY.
Sky Striker Mecha - Shark Cannon
Banishes or steals a monster from their GY.
Sky Striker Mecha - Eagle Booster
Quick-Play: protects a monster from every other effect.
